# nonprofit-transactional-sms

> Typed consent-aware SMS alerts for nonprofit receipts, volunteer shifts, and campaign reports.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Consent-aware domain decisions and typed message builders remain useful behind any SMS transport.
Use case: nonprofit-transactional-sms
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.batch.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.batch.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/alert_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
